name: KMC Colombia
tradition: New Kadampa Tradition (NKT-IKBU), Gelug-derived Modern Kadampa Buddhism
technique: Lamrim-based analytical and placement meditation on calm-abiding, lovingkindness, and the nature of mind, following the teachings of Geshe Kelsang Gyatso
influences: New Kadampa Tradition - International Kadampa Buddhist Union (NKT-IKBU)
teacherAccess: Resident teacher Gen Kelsang Namdrol and visiting NKT teachers give teachings and lead guided meditation sessions during weekend retreats, with dedicated Q&A time.
retreatOptions: Periodic weekend residential retreats (Friday evening through Sunday, 2 nights) held at a rented finca outside Bogotá (e.g., in Fómeque/Choachí); weekly classes and courses at the Bogotá center itself are day-only.
about: KMC Colombia is a Kadampa Buddhist meditation center in Bogotá, part of the New Kadampa Tradition - International Kadampa Buddhist Union (NKT-IKBU) founded by Geshe Kelsang Gyatso Rinpoche. The first Kadampa practitioners arrived in Colombia in 2011, and the center's Bogotá meditation hall opened in 2016 under resident teacher Gen Kelsang Sangtön; it is now led by Gen Kelsang Namdrol. Alongside its daily and weekly non-residential classes in Bogotá, the center periodically runs weekend residential retreats — typically Friday evening through Sunday — at a rented finca outside the city, combining teachings from a qualified Kadampa teacher with guided meditation sessions on themes such as resting in the clarity of the mind. Retreat packages include meals, drinks, and onsite lodging, with an off-site lodging option also available nearby.
schedule: Weekend retreat runs Friday dinner through Sunday lunch with six guided meditation sessions plus teachings; the Bogotá temple otherwise holds weekly non-residential classes and courses.
cost: Fixed registration fee per retreat, tiered by room type, with an early-bird discount; a no-lodging option is available for local attendees.

pricePerDay.notes: Early-bird weekend retreat (2 nights, Fri-Sun) at a rented finca in Fómeque: COP 690,000 shared-bath to COP 790,000 private-bath package, divided by 2 nights; standard pricing after the early-bird deadline rises to COP 770,000-867,000 for the package.

foodNotes: Meals and drinks are included in the weekend retreat package; specific dietary style not published.
